rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of return type from parseExitCode
rawFindings.explanation: The function parseExitCode was modified to return an object with properties 'exitCode' and 'buffer', but in exports.run the code still assumes it returns just the exit code integer and a buffer. This causes exitCode to be assigned the entire object and leads to process.stdout.write receiving an object instead of a buffer, which will break output streaming.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the handling inside the 'data' event in exports.run to unpack the returned object correctly: var parsedResult = parseExitCode(buffer, exitCode, config.failOnEmptyTestSuite); exitCode = parsedResult.exitCode; process.stdout.write(parsedResult.buffer);
